punchline: According to Adam Grant, givers stand at both the very bottom and the very top of the ladder of success.
thirty_sec: Adam Grant divides people into takers, matchers and givers. When he studied engineers, salespeople and medical students, he found givers both at the bottom and at the top. The giver at the bottom wears himself out and cannot say no. The giver at the top is generous too, but knows how to set limits and spot takers. The difference is in the way of giving.
